The main callers of `useVisit` in the patient chart are the banner visit tag, the visit-attribute banner tag, the stop/delete/end-visit actions, the visit forms, and the patient-chart resolver hook. The hook is defined in `openmrs-esm-core`. Its list of 47 chart references, from a grep plus a symbol lookup, matched 19 files. I excluded the vitals test, which only imports `useVisit`.

**Definition (openmrs-esm-core)**
- `openmrs-esm-core/packages/framework/esm-react-utils/src/useVisit.ts:52-141` is the hook itself. It returns `activeVisit`, `currentVisit`, `isLoading`, `mutate` and the deprecated fields.

**Production callers, most likely affected**
- `openmrs-esm-patient-chart/packages/esm-patient-chart-app/src/patient-chart/patient-chart.resources.ts:73-238` (`usePatientChartPatientAndVisit`) uses `useVisit` to set the chart's visit context and launch the workspace group.
- `openmrs-esm-patient-chart/packages/esm-patient-banner-app/src/banner-tags/visit-tag.extension.tsx:13-21` (`VisitTag`) shows the "Active Visit" tag from `activeVisit` and `isLoading`.
- `openmrs-esm-patient-chart/packages/esm-patient-chart-app/src/patient-banner-tags/visit-attribute-tags.extension.tsx:36-64` (`VisitAttributeTags`) renders banner tags from `activeVisit.attributes`.
- `openmrs-esm-patient-chart/packages/esm-patient-chart-app/src/actions-buttons/stop-visit.component.tsx:16-37` shows "End active visit" only when `activeVisit` is set.
- `openmrs-esm-patient-chart/packages/esm-patient-chart-app/src/actions-buttons/delete-visit.component.tsx:16-39` shows "Delete active visit" and passes `activeVisit` to the modal.
- `openmrs-esm-patient-chart/packages/esm-patient-chart-app/src/visit/visit-prompt/end-visit-dialog.modal.tsx:20-80` uses `activeVisit` and `mutate` to end the visit.
- `openmrs-esm-patient-chart/packages/esm-patient-chart-app/src/visit/visit-form/visit-form.workspace.tsx:32-64` calls `mutate` from `useVisit` after a visit is started.
- `openmrs-esm-patient-chart/packages/esm-patient-chart-app/src/visit/visit-form/exported-visit-form.workspace.tsx:115-135` reads `activeVisit` and `isLoading` for the visit form. The line 135 call is confirmed, but the component's end line is not, so this range is partial.
- `openmrs-esm-patient-chart/packages/esm-patient-common-lib/src/visit/visit-mutations.ts:1-3` imports `useVisit` but does not call it. Its optimistic-update helpers rely on the same SWR cache keys.
- `openmrs-esm-patient-chart/packages/esm-patient-common-lib/src/visit/revalidation-utils.ts:87-87` is a comment saying these components depend on `useVisit`. It is not a call.

**Tests and mocks (would only be affected if the mock shape changed)**
- `openmrs-esm-patient-chart/packages/esm-patient-chart-app/src/visit/visit-form/visit-form.test.tsx:105-1138` mocks `useVisit` across many cases; I only confirmed line 105 and the lines around 1055-1138 from grep.
- `openmrs-esm-patient-chart/packages/esm-patient-chart-app/src/actions-buttons/stop-visit.test.tsx:10-17`, `openmrs-esm-patient-chart/packages/esm-patient-chart-app/src/actions-buttons/delete-visit.test.tsx:9-16`, `openmrs-esm-patient-chart/packages/esm-patient-chart-app/src/visit/visit-prompt/end-visit-dialog.test.tsx:25-25`, `openmrs-esm-patient-chart/packages/esm-patient-chart-app/src/patient-banner-tags/visit-attribute-tags.test.tsx:9-34`, `openmrs-esm-patient-chart/packages/esm-patient-chart-app/src/patient-chart/patient-chart.resources.test.ts:21-21`, `openmrs-esm-patient-chart/packages/esm-patient-banner-app/src/banner-tags/visit-tag.test.tsx:10-10`, `openmrs-esm-patient-chart/packages/esm-patient-immunizations-app/src/immunizations/immunizations-detailed-summary.test.tsx:35-35`.
- `openmrs-esm-core/packages/framework/esm-react-utils/mock.tsx:95-95` and `openmrs-esm-core/packages/framework/esm-react-utils/mock-jest.tsx:90-90` are the shared mocks the chart tests rely on. A behaviour change in the real hook would not reach these tests; they would need updating only if the returned shape changed.

I did not check the core's Storybook mock (`openmrs-esm-core/packages/tooling/storybook/mocks/esm-react-utils.ts:160`) or the `openmrs-esm-core` docs. I used the 10 search calls and about 14 of the 20 read calls. No files were modified.
